title: Israel's Health Ministry warns hospitals and health funds of a possible large-scale coordinated cyberattack
date_note: The 9tv article, published 27 November, says the ministry's urgent notice went out overnight on Friday; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: Israel's Health Ministry warned hospitals and health funds of a possible large-scale coordinated cyberattack on the country's medical system, 9tv reports. The report says the attack vector is unknown and does not say an attack has begun. Maccabi told staff it had temporarily disabled connections to internal systems from abroad.
plain: Israel's Health Ministry has warned hospitals and health funds about a possible large coordinated cyberattack. No attack is reported to have started. Maccabi has temporarily cut remote access from abroad.
exec: A national health ministry has put hospitals and health funds on alert, and one health fund has restricted remote access from abroad, per 9tv.
action: General advice: follow the Health Ministry's notice and report suspicious activity to the National Cyber Directorate.
geo_basis: Issued by the national Health Ministry; seat of government used.

sources.name: 9tv.co.il: Больницы Израиля готовятся к кибератаке: Минздрав объявил повышенную готовность

validation.note: Only 9tv.co.il read; the ministry's own notice was not found, so its wording is relayed by 9tv.

review.note: duplicate: same Health Ministry warning as the earlier record; set duplicate_of, source merged there
